shots.name: ascii-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with an ASCII card: Style menu, Preset menu showing Shade Blocks, Cell Size, Amount, Background, Black Level and Invert Ramp, then Ramp, Custom Ramp, Font and Weight, then Color Source with Dark and Light dimmed under the note Used with Color Source Duotone, beside a strip of the preview where the dancer is built from shaded blocks
shots.caption: ASCII with the Shade Blocks preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Cell Size. 3 — Background. 4 — Ramp: the characters, here Blocks. 5 — Color Source.

shots.name: glyph-matrix-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Glyph Matrix card: Style menu, Preset menu showing Data Wave, Cell Size, Amount, Background, Black Level and Invert Ramp, then Ramp, Custom Ramp, Font and Weight, then Color Source with Dark and Light dimmed under the note Used with Color Source Duotone, then Speed and Roll, beside a strip of the preview where the dancer is built from rising bars in diagonal stripes
shots.caption: Glyph Matrix with the Data Wave preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Cell Size. 3 — Background. 4 — Ramp: the characters, here Bars. 5 — Roll: how far they roll through the ramp.

shots.name: symbol-matrix-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Symbol Matrix card: Style menu, Preset menu showing Shape Shift, Cell Size, Amount, Background, Black Level and Invert Ramp, then Ramp dimmed under the note Used while Custom Ramp is empty, Custom Ramp with a row of shapes, Font and Weight, then Color Source with Dark and Light dimmed under the note Used with Color Source Duotone, then Speed, Roll and Twinkle, beside a strip of the preview where the dancer is built from circles, diamonds, triangles and squares
shots.caption: Symbol Matrix with the Shape Shift preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Custom Ramp: the signs, here shapes. 3 — Speed: how often they swap. 4 — Roll: how far they may swap. 5 — Twinkle: how deep they breathe.

shots.name: retro-matrix-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Retro Matrix card: Style menu, Preset menu showing Teletype, Cell Size, Amount, Background, Black Level, Invert Ramp and Scanlines, then Ramp, Custom Ramp, Font and Weight, then Phosphor with an amber swatch, then Speed and Roll, beside a strip of the preview where the dancer's arm is drawn in large amber digits
shots.caption: Retro Matrix with the Teletype preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Cell Size. 3 — Scanlines: the lines of the screen. 4 — Phosphor: the colour of the text. 5 — Speed: how fast it scrolls.

shots.name: matrix-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Matrix Rain card: Style menu, Preset menu showing Code Portrait, Cell Size, Amount, Background, Black Level and Invert Ramp, then Ramp, Custom Ramp, Font and Weight, then Rain Color with a green swatch, then Speed, Roll and Trail, beside a strip of the preview where the dancer is drawn in green digits on a black stage
shots.caption: Matrix Rain with the Code Portrait preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Cell Size. 3 — Black Level: empties the dark stage. 4 — Rain Color: the colour of the code. 5 — Trail: how long the falling tails are.

shots.name: grid-glyph-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Grid Glyph card: Style menu, Preset menu showing Circuit Board, then Cell Size, Line Width and Line Glow, then Amount, Background, Black Level and Invert Ramp, then Ramp set to Binary, Custom Ramp, Font and Weight, then Color Source set to Duotone with a deep blue Dark and a pale cyan Light, beside a strip of the preview where the dancer is drawn in cyan zeros and ones in a fine lit grid
shots.caption: Grid Glyph with the Circuit Board preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Cell Size. 3 — Line Width: how thick the lines are. 4 — Line Glow: how brightly they shine. 5 — Color Source: here Duotone.
